body: I added an owner-driven information-architecture note to the docs bead. It turns getting-started into a front door and organizes the large library as five capability journeys: build a story model; represent recall/interview; compute lexical/structural features; align and interpret; save and reproduce. It also defines a per-page contract of runnable public Scala, byte-bound output, explanation, limits, next link, and a useful static figure plus text twin. No shared docs edits; finish the chief P0 and B0R work first.
